title: New Positive Strings at a Stage
statement: Let $(N_j)_{j\ge0}$ be a sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines, let $i$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $z$ be a Boolean string. If $z$ is positive at stage $i+1$ but not positive at stage $i$, then $z$ is the witness selected at stage $i$, and machine $N_i$ does not accept its specified unary input within $n_i^i+i$ steps relative to the stage-$i$ positive-set oracle, where $n_i$ is the fresh length for that stage.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines N
Membership of z in the positive set at stage i+1
Nonmembership of z in the positive set at stage i
